meta.precision_rule: two significant figures; per-participant figures to the nearest $1,000; two designs whose per-participant figures round to the same $1,000 are not ranked against each other on that measure (MOO-183 §6)
caveats: Two significant figures. No figure in this package is a VRS actuarial result.
Participant counts are MODELED DEMAND, not actual cap utilisation. No participant count in this programme has an external anchor: no published count of purchases under § 51.1-142.2 exists.
18.4 participants is an UPPER BOUND. Clause (viii) of "eligible member" is in the live draft at document revision 76 and in no committed run, and can only refuse more.
The 12-month rung is the CHEAP END of the retirement window: +7.5% uniform across the permissible dates, +16.3% all at the earliest date (MOO-85 §4).

S8 publication restriction: the S8 family's comparative dollar cells at statutory interest rates other than the decided 6.00% are internal under the board's standing restriction. Every such row in this run is tagged publication_restricted = true and must not reach a sponsor-facing artifact. Participant counts are not dollar figures.
Pre-decisional and internal. Release is the Policy Director's decision.
